# Ajsan

> A professional home and commercial services company based in Tallinn, Estonia, operating across Harjumaa. Core trades include plumbing, electrical work, renovation, and building maintenance.

## Primary URLs

- [Estonian](https://ajsan.ee/et/): Peamine eestikeelne veebileht teenuste infoga.
- [English](https://ajsan.ee/en/): Main website in English with service details.
- [Russian](https://ajsan.ee/ru/): Основной сайт на русском языке с информацией об услугах.

## Key Service Sections

- [Services Index](https://ajsan.ee/et/teenused): Browse all available trades and maintenance services.
- [Price List](https://ajsan.ee/et/hinnakiri): Hourly rates and service fees with VAT.
- [Emergency Plumbing 24/7](https://ajsan.ee/et/teenused/plumber-24h-tallinn): Immediate assistance for pipe leaks and sewer issues.
- [Electrical Works](https://ajsan.ee/et/teenused/electrician-services): Licensed electrical installations and repairs.
- [Bathroom Renovation](https://ajsan.ee/et/teenused/bathroom-repair): Full bathroom remodeling and plumbing updates.
- [Blog](https://ajsan.ee/et/blogi): Maintenance tips and plumbing advice for homeowners.
- [Contact](https://ajsan.ee/et/kontakt): Phone and email details for bookings and emergency help.

## Legal Details

- [Terms of Service](https://ajsan.ee/et/tingimused): Standard conditions of service and liability.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ajsan.ee/et/privaatsuspoliitika): How we handle your data and cookies.
